description: Infinite scroll with cursor-based Firestore pagination for Feed, Discover, and Reels pages using IntersectionObserver
steps: Create src/hooks/useInfiniteFirestore.ts - a reusable hook that accepts a Firestore query builder, page size, and order field. It should use startAfter() with the last document snapshot for cursor-based pagination. Returns { data, loading, hasMore, loadMore, refresh }. Use useRef to store the last document snapshot for startAfter cursor.

Modify src/pages/Feed.tsx - replace the single getDocs(limit(10)) call with useInfiniteFirestore. Add an IntersectionObserver sentinel div at the bottom of the posts list that triggers loadMore. Show a loading spinner (a simple animated div with tailwind) at the bottom when fetching. Add pull-to-refresh: detect touchstart/touchmove at top of scroll container and call refresh().
Modify src/pages/Discover.tsx - paginate the profiles query using useInfiniteFirestore. Add a sentinel div at the bottom of the 'All creators' section to load more profiles.
Modify src/pages/Reels.tsx - use useInfiniteFirestore for reels loading. When the user approaches the last few reels in the snap-scroll container, load more.
Create a simple LoadingSpinner component at src/components/ui/loading-spinner.tsx - a small spinning circle using tailwind animate-spin for use as the bottom-of-feed indicator
acceptance_criteria: Feed.tsx uses cursor-based pagination and loads more posts on scroll
Reels.tsx loads more reels as user scrolls
A loading spinner appears at the bottom when fetching more
verification: Run: source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && cd /projects/sandbox/Parallaxai && npm run build
Run: source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && cd /projects/sandbox/Parallaxai && npm run test
findings: All 33 tests pass. Build completes in ~9s. The hook uses useRef for the last DocumentSnapshot cursor and useCallback for stable loadMore/refresh references. Discover.tsx still uses getDocs with limit(6) for the trending posts section since that is a separate one-shot query, not paginated. The hook returns hasMore based on whether the last page returned fewer docs than pageSize.
